question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

She will already return home / when her parents get back / from their offices.
solution:
The correct answer is **'She will already return home'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points __**

__
 
• In this complex sentence the **auxiliary verbs** and the **main verbs** both are in the same form and voice.
 
• This sentence is of **future perfect tense** **(Subject + will have + past participle + verb + Object).**
 
• Thus, the correct tense will be** '**will have already returned' rather than 'will already return home'.
 
• For example:
 
 
• By this time next year Shalini will take her university degree. **(Incorrect)**
 
• By this time next year Shalini will have taken her university degree. **(Correct)**
 
 

** Therefore, the correct sentence should be:** *She **will have returned** home when her parents get back from their offices*. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• However, there are also cases where the form and voice of **auxiliary verbs** and the **main verbs** are different. 
 
• For example: 
 
 
• Sheetal has not failed and will not fail in the near future.
